purpose: Verify an authorized Institute Employee may perform an operational file-processing action
preconditions: A user exists who is an Institute Employee (Faculty/Staff) operating under an assigned role that authorizes the operational action
action_or_input: The Institute Employee requests an operational file action (for example, creating a file)
expected_result: The operational file action is allowed and processed

purpose: Verify System Admin is excluded from routine operational file processing
preconditions: A System Admin user exists who is not acting as an Institute Employee with an operational role
action_or_input: The System Admin requests a routine operational file action (for example, forwarding a file)
expected_result: The operational file action is not permitted

purpose: Verify System Admin governance actions are permitted only within the separate governance scope
preconditions: A System Admin user exists
An FTS governance action within the governance scope is available
action_or_input: The System Admin performs an FTS governance action within the governance scope
expected_result: The governance action is permitted, and no routine operational file-processing capability is granted by it

purpose: Verify a user who is not an Institute Employee cannot perform operational file actions
preconditions: A user exists who is not an Institute Employee and is not authorized for operational file processing
action_or_input: The user requests an operational file action
expected_result: The operational file action is not permitted

purpose: Verify role switching preserves existing file ownership and previously recorded audit history, and that the selected role governs authorization
preconditions: An Institute Employee holds at least two assigned roles
The employee owns at least one file with existing audit history recorded under the current role context
action_or_input: The employee selects another assigned role context, then views owned files and audit history and attempts an action
expected_result: File ownership is unchanged, previously recorded audit entries retain their original identity, and authorization is applied according to the newly selected role

purpose: Verify a file and its accumulated contents persist after circulation
preconditions: A file exists with an initial comment and an attachment
The file has been circulated by forwarding to another Institute Employee with a movement comment
action_or_input: Retrieve the file, its comments, attachments and movement records after circulation
expected_result: The file, its comments, its attachments and its movement records are all retained and retrievable

purpose: Verify circulated contents are not deleted through draft-discard behavior
preconditions: A file has been circulated and contains comments and movement records
action_or_input: Attempt to discard the circulated file as a draft
expected_result: The discard is not applied and the file and its accumulated contents remain intact

purpose: Verify attachments are optional while the comment is mandatory for creation
preconditions: An Institute Employee is authorized to create files
action_or_input: Create a file with an initial comment and no attachments
expected_result: The file is accepted and persisted without any attachment

purpose: Verify a pre-submission draft may be discarded (exception to persistence)
preconditions: A file exists in pre-submission draft state that has not been circulated
action_or_input: Discard the draft
expected_result: The draft is discarded as permitted by BR-FTS-005

purpose: Verify file creation is blocked without an initial comment
preconditions: An Institute Employee is authorized to create files
action_or_input: Attempt to create/save a new file with no initial comment
expected_result: File creation is not accepted until an initial comment is provided

purpose: Verify file creation is accepted when an initial comment is present
preconditions: An Institute Employee is authorized to create files
action_or_input: Create a new file with an initial comment
expected_result: File creation is accepted

purpose: Verify draft save, edit and discard are permitted before circulation
preconditions: A file exists in pre-circulation draft state
action_or_input: Save the draft, edit the draft, and discard the draft
expected_result: Each draft operation is permitted while the file is in the pre-circulation state

purpose: Verify a circulated file cannot be deleted as a draft
preconditions: A file has been submitted/circulated
action_or_input: Attempt draft deletion/discard on the circulated file
expected_result: Draft deletion is prevented and the file remains

purpose: Verify forwarding is blocked without a movement comment
preconditions: An Institute Employee holds a file they are permitted to forward
A valid Institute Employee recipient exists
action_or_input: Attempt to forward the file with no movement comment
expected_result: The forward is blocked until a movement comment is supplied

purpose: Verify returning is blocked without a movement comment
preconditions: An Institute Employee holds a received file that they are permitted to return
action_or_input: Attempt to return the file with no movement comment
expected_result: The return is blocked until a movement comment is supplied

purpose: Verify forwarding and returning succeed when a movement comment is supplied
preconditions: An Institute Employee holds a file they are permitted to forward
A valid Institute Employee recipient exists
A received file exists that the user is permitted to return
action_or_input: Forward a file with a movement comment; return a received file with a movement comment
expected_result: Both movements are accepted

purpose: Verify a file may be sent to another Institute Employee regardless of the receiver's role
preconditions: A sender is permitted to forward a file
Two valid Institute Employee recipients exist who hold different roles
action_or_input: Forward the file with a movement comment to each recipient in turn (using separate files or successive movements)
expected_result: Each recipient is accepted irrespective of role

purpose: Verify a recipient who is not a valid Institute Employee is not accepted
preconditions: A sender is permitted to forward a file
A recipient candidate exists who is not a valid Institute Employee
action_or_input: Attempt to forward the file with a movement comment to that recipient
expected_result: The recipient is not accepted and the file is not sent

purpose: Verify a received file is returned to the sender of the received movement
preconditions: User B has received a file from User A
User B is permitted to act on the file
action_or_input: User B returns the file with a movement comment
expected_result: The file is routed to User A, the sender of the received movement

purpose: Verify return is subject to authorization/file-state permissions
preconditions: A user is not permitted to act on a received file under authorization or file-state permissions
action_or_input: The user attempts to return the file with a movement comment
expected_result: The return is not permitted

purpose: Verify a successful forward is recorded with sender, receiver, timestamp, comment and attachments
preconditions: A permitted sender and a valid recipient exist
The movement includes a comment and an attachment
action_or_input: Forward the file with a movement comment and an attachment
expected_result: A movement event is appended to the history containing sender, receiver, timestamp, movement comment and the movement attachment

purpose: Verify a movement without attachments is still recorded (attachments only where present)
preconditions: A permitted sender and a valid recipient exist
action_or_input: Forward the file with a movement comment and no attachment
expected_result: A movement event is recorded with sender, receiver, timestamp and comment, and no attachment is listed

purpose: Verify a successful return is recorded in the movement history
preconditions: A received file exists that the user is permitted to return
action_or_input: Return the file with a movement comment
expected_result: A return movement event is appended with sender, receiver, timestamp and movement comment

purpose: Verify movement events are kept in chronological order and holder/pending-recipient information is updated consistently
preconditions: A file has undergone at least two successive movements (forward then return, or forward then forward)
action_or_input: View the file movement history and current holder/pending-recipient information
expected_result: Events appear in chronological order and the holder/pending-recipient information is consistent with the most recent movement

purpose: Verify an authorized associated user can access a file and its history through Inbox/Outbox
preconditions: A user is authorized and associated with a file (as sender or receiver)
action_or_input: The user opens Inbox/Outbox and opens the file and its history
expected_result: The associated file is listed and its contents and history can be opened

purpose: Verify files/history are not exposed to users who are not authorized and associated
preconditions: A user exists who is not associated with or not authorized for a given file
action_or_input: The user requests that file and its history, and views Inbox/Outbox
expected_result: The file and its history are not exposed or opened, and the file is not listed in the user's Inbox/Outbox

purpose: Verify archived files remain readable to authorized users
preconditions: A file has been archived
A user is authorized and associated with the file
action_or_input: The user opens the archived file and its history
expected_result: The archived file contents and history are readable

purpose: Verify an action authorized by role, context, file association and file state is permitted
preconditions: A user holds an assigned role, is associated with a file, and the file state allows the action
action_or_input: The user requests a protected FTS action on the file
expected_result: The action is permitted

purpose: Verify an action is rejected when the user's role/assigned-role context does not authorize it
preconditions: A user's selected role context does not authorize a sensitive FTS action
action_or_input: The user requests the sensitive action
expected_result: The action is rejected

purpose: Verify an action is rejected when the user has no association with the file
preconditions: A user holds a role that could otherwise authorize the action but is not associated with the file
action_or_input: The user requests a protected action on the file
expected_result: The action is rejected

purpose: Verify an action is rejected when the file state does not authorize it
preconditions: A file is in a state that does not authorize the requested action (for example, archived)
action_or_input: A user associated with the file requests the action
expected_result: The action is rejected

purpose: Verify RBAC is enforced for integration invocations of FTS actions
preconditions: A consuming module invokes an FTS action on behalf of a user who is not authorized for that action
action_or_input: Invoke the FTS action through the integration
expected_result: The unauthorized action is rejected

purpose: Verify audit records are created for creation, comments, attachments, forwarding and return
preconditions: An authorized user creates a file with a comment and an attachment, forwards it, and a recipient returns it
action_or_input: Review the audit records for the file
expected_result: Audit records exist for creation, comments, attachments, forwarding and return

purpose: Verify an audit record is created for archival
preconditions: The file owner archives a completed circulated file
action_or_input: Review the audit records for the file
expected_result: An audit record exists for the archival action

purpose: Verify an audit record is created for integration actions
preconditions: A consuming Fusion module invokes an authorized FTS service
action_or_input: Review the audit records after the integration action
expected_result: An audit record exists for the integration action

purpose: Verify chronological version history is maintained and prior history is not rewritten
preconditions: A file has existing audit/version history
A further auditable action occurs on the file
action_or_input: Perform the action, then review the audit/version history
expected_result: A new record is appended chronologically and previously recorded entries remain unchanged

purpose: Verify the file owner may archive a completed circulated file
preconditions: A circulated file exists whose collaborative processing is complete
The acting user is the file owner
action_or_input: The owner requests archival
expected_result: The file is archived

purpose: Verify a user who is not the file owner cannot archive the file
preconditions: A circulated file exists
The acting user is associated with the file but is not the owner
action_or_input: The non-owner requests archival
expected_result: Archival is not permitted and the file is not archived

purpose: Verify an archived file cannot be modified
preconditions: A file has been archived
action_or_input: An authorized user attempts to modify the archived file
expected_result: The modification is rejected; the file remains read-only

purpose: Verify an archived file cannot be forwarded
preconditions: A file has been archived
action_or_input: An authorized user attempts to forward the archived file with a movement comment
expected_result: The forward is rejected

purpose: Verify an archived file remains permanently stored and readable to authorized users
preconditions: A file has been archived
action_or_input: An authorized user reads the archived file
expected_result: The archived file remains stored and readable

purpose: Verify a notification is triggered when a file is received
preconditions: A file is sent to a valid Institute Employee
action_or_input: Complete the movement that delivers the file
expected_result: A file-received notification event is created and handed to the Fusion notification mechanism

purpose: Verify a notification is triggered when a file is forwarded
preconditions: A permitted user forwards a file with a movement comment
action_or_input: Complete the forward
expected_result: A file-forwarded notification event is created and handed to the Fusion notification mechanism

purpose: Verify a notification is triggered when a file is returned
preconditions: A permitted user returns a received file with a movement comment
action_or_input: Complete the return
expected_result: A file-returned notification event is created and handed to the Fusion notification mechanism

purpose: Verify a notification is triggered when a file is archived
preconditions: The owner archives a completed circulated file
action_or_input: Complete the archival
expected_result: A file-archived notification event is created and handed to the Fusion notification mechanism

purpose: Verify notifications are triggered for relevant role assignment/reassignment events
preconditions: A relevant role assignment or reassignment event occurs for an Institute Employee
action_or_input: Complete the role assignment/reassignment
expected_result: A role assignment/reassignment notification event is created and handed to the Fusion notification mechanism

purpose: Verify FTS provides file/workflow tracking capabilities to a consuming module when authorized
preconditions: A consuming Fusion module invokes an FTS tracking service under an authorized role/context
action_or_input: Invoke the FTS service (file/workflow tracking, approval-chain support, or file-based request tracking)
expected_result: The authorized capability is provided and the invocation is subject to FTS RBAC and audit rules

purpose: Verify unauthorized capabilities are not provided to a consuming module
preconditions: A consuming module invokes an FTS service for which the requesting context is not authorized under FTS RBAC
action_or_input: Invoke the FTS service
expected_result: The capability is not provided

purpose: Verify FTS does not assume ownership of consuming-module domain-specific policy
preconditions: A consuming module invokes an FTS service and retains its own domain-specific approval rules and semantics
action_or_input: Invoke the FTS service for a domain-specific request
expected_result: FTS provides tracking capabilities only and does not apply or define the consuming module's domain-specific actors, forms, policies, validations or workflow semantics
